remarks: The Malibu Ranch - Peaceful, Restorative, Private, Sophisticated, and Refined. This extraordinary single-story modern ranch estate offers a rare blend of complete privacy, sustainability, wellness, and breathtaking natural beauty. With nearly 6 private acres in the rolling hills of Malibu, spanning approximately 5,100 square feet, the home has been meticulously reimagined from its original 1958 ranch roots into a fully modern, architecturally refined retreat where panoramic ocean, mountain, sunrise, and sunset views become part of everyday life.
